summary: Bitstream decompression core: decodes a Huffman-style token stream (length/literal tree a3 plus a distance tree a4) into an output buffer, using an LZ77 window with back-references. State is threaded through caller-supplied structures: bit accumulator and cursor live in a5[7]/a5[8]/a5[13], output bounds in a5[10]/a5[11]/a5[12], and the input cursor/limit in a6[0]/a6[1]/a6[2]. Bit masking uses the shared 0x005DBB90 lookup table indexed by a1/a2 and by tree-entry flag bytes. Returns 1 on a valid terminal match, -3 on invalid literal/distance (writing the matching error string into a6[6]), and 0 when output space or input is exhausted.

operations.description: Load input stream state from a6: v6 = *a6 (read cursor) and v45 = a6[1] (remaining input bytes).
Load output and bit state from a5: v7 = a5[13] (write cursor), v8 = a5[12] (capacity), v9 = a5[8] (bit accumulator), v10 = a5[7] (bit position).
Compute remaining output space v47: if the cursor is at or past capacity use a5[11] - cursor, otherwise capacity - cursor - 1.
Load the two table bit-mask values v51 = dword_5DBB90[a2] and v50 = dword_5DBB90[a1] from the shared 0x005DBB90 lookup table.
Outer decode loop: repeat while remaining output space v47 >= 0x102 and remaining input v45 >= 0xA.
Refill the bit accumulator from input bytes until at least 0x14 bits are buffered, shifting in 8 bits per byte and decrementing v45.
Look up the first (length/literal) tree entry: v12 = a3 + 8 * (v9 & v50) and read its flag byte v13.
Walk the length/literal tree: shift the accumulator by the entry's bit count, follow sub-table offsets (v12 += 8 * [v12+4] + 8 * (v9 & dword_5DBB90[v13])) until a terminal flag is reached.
Tree terminal flag 0x10: a match token was decoded; take the low nibble v16 = v13 & 0xF as the extra bit count and compute the length value v46 from the entry plus the mask table.
Tree terminal flags 0x40|0x20: valid terminal match; save the bit/input/output state back to a5 and a6 and return 1.
Tree terminal flag 0x40 without 0x20: invalid literal; store the error string aInvalidLiteral_0 into the a6[6] error-slot, save state, and return -3.
Decode the distance: look up v49 = a4 + 8 * (v9 & v51) in the distance tree and walk it the same way as the length tree.
Distance-tree terminal flag 0x40: invalid distance; store the error string aInvalidDistanc_0 into the a6[6] error-slot, save state, and return -3.
Distance-tree terminal flag 0x10: compute the distance value v22 from the entry plus the mask table, consume the remaining extra bits, and reduce the remaining output space v47 by the length v46.
LZ77 back-reference copy: copy v46 bytes from (v7 - v22) into the output at v7, wrapping through the window base a5[10] / boundary a5[11] when the distance crosses the window start; advance v7.
Literal path: when a tree entry is empty (flag byte 0), emit the stored literal byte v12[4], advance v7, and decrement the remaining output space v47.
When the outer loop exits (v47 < 0x102 or v45 < 0xA), save the remaining bit and stream state back into a5[7]/a5[8]/a5[13] and a6[0]/a6[1]/a6[2], and return 0.
